packages.title: Meghalaya – Abode of Clouds
packages.description: Meghalaya, meaning “Abode of Clouds,” is a beautiful state in Northeast India known for its lush green hills, waterfalls, caves, and unique living root bridges. From the scenic beauty of Shillong and Sohra to the crystal-clear waters of Dawki and Asia’s cleanest village Mawlynong, Meghalaya offers an unforgettable journey.
highlights: Scenic drive from Guwahati to Shillong & Police Bazar
Seven Sisters, Nohkalikai & Wei Sawdong Waterfalls
Mawsmai Cave, Arwah Cave & Mawsawa Falls in Cherrapunji
Crystal-clear Umngot River Boating in Dawki
India–Bangladesh Border at Tamabil
Asia’s Cleanest Village Mawlynong & Living Root Bridge
Ward’s Lake, Elephant Falls & Shillong Peak
Majestic Umiam Lake (Barapani) en route
itinerary: Day 1: Guwahati to Shillong – Check-in & Police Bazar
Day 2: Shillong to Cherrapunji – Waterfalls & Caves Exploration
Day 3: Cherrapunji to Dawki & Mawlynong – Umngot River Boating
Day 4: Mawlynong to Shillong – Living Root Bridge & City Sightseeing
Day 5: Shillong to Guwahati via Umiam Lake – Departure

itineraryDetails.title: Guwahati to Shillong (98 km / Approx. 4 hrs)
itineraryDetails.desc: Pick up from Guwahati and transfer to Shillong. Shillong is a beautiful hill station and the capital of Meghalaya, known for its scenic beauty, waterfalls, and colonial charm. On reaching, check in to the hotel and rest. In the evening, explore the vibrant Police Bazar. Dinner will be served at the Shillong hotel.

itineraryDetails.title: Shillong to Cherrapunji (54 km / Approx. 2.5 hrs)
itineraryDetails.desc: After breakfast check out from Shillong hotel and proceed to Cherrapunji, one of the wettest places on earth, famous for waterfalls, caves, and natural beauty. Visit iconic falls and mystical limestone caves. Dinner will be served at the Cherrapunji hotel.

itineraryDetails.title: Cherrapunji to Dawki & Mawlynong (73 km / Approx. 4.5 hrs)
itineraryDetails.desc: After breakfast check out from Cherrapunji hotel and proceed towards Dawki and Mawlynong. Experience the crystal-clear waters of Umngot River and visit the India–Bangladesh border at Tamabil. Later proceed to Mawlynong – Asia’s cleanest village. Dinner will be served at the Mawlynong homestay.

itineraryDetails.title: Mawlynong to Shillong (67 km / Approx. 5 hrs)
itineraryDetails.desc: Early morning explore Mawlynong village on foot, surrounded by lush greenery and Khasi culture, and walk across the single Decker Living Root Bridge. After breakfast check out and proceed to Shillong for full city sightseeing. Dinner will be served at the Shillong hotel.

itineraryDetails.title: Shillong to Guwahati (98 km / Approx. 4 hrs)
itineraryDetails.desc: After breakfast check out from Shillong hotel and proceed to Guwahati. Enroute visit the picturesque Umiam Lake (Barapani). Drop at Guwahati Airport or Kamakhya Railway Station with everlasting memories of the Abode of Clouds.

includes: Private cab for entire trip (Guwahati to Guwahati)
excludes: Any meal not mentioned in itinerary
childPolicy: Above 5 years: chargeable, with discount applicable.

packages.title: Darjeeling
packages.description: Nestled in the foothills of the Eastern Himalayas, Darjeeling is one of India's most loved hill stations. Known as the Queen of Hills, it offers breathtaking views of Mt. Kanchenjunga, rolling tea gardens, colonial charm, and the spectacular sunrise from Tiger Hill. Perfect for family vacations, honeymoon trips, and relaxing hill getaways.
